newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling up on dollar, falls on pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling up on dollar, falls on pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling gained against the dollar on Tuesday but fell on the pound, the central Bank of Tanzania said.
Against the dollar, the shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 600.1281 compared to Monday's 600.1380.

The shilling depreciated against the pound exchanging for 970.8587 compared to Monday's 962.4128. The pound is not widely traded in the local market and dealers said this explained its greater volatility compared to the dollar.
